d: In the couple special episode of Guest in the Newsroom, Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal joined as guests. Ali shared insights about the storyline of the film Mirzapur, while Richa discussed her iconic role as Bholi Punjaban in Fukrey. The couple openly talked about their marriage, children, and films. They also expressed their views on politics and religion. Adding to the conversation, Richa and Ali had a great time enjoying themselves in the newsroom. Watch this special episode of Couple in the Newsroom with Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal.
